Hi Tim — thanks for the clear list. Summary + immediate next steps below. I copied Marcus (product infra) and Laura (legal/compliance) so they can own the artifacts and questionnaire response respectively.

Short summary (one paragraph): Redwood is currently a SOC 2 Type II in-progress: control run period completed 2026-12-31, auditor engagement underway, final report expected Q3 2027 (we target July). For logging: we provide admin activity logs (console/API admin actions), API request/response logs (caller, endpoint, timestamp, status), and inference-level metadata (request id, model variant, token counts). Logs are exportable to S3-compatible buckets or as compressed NDJSON/CSV snapshots. Retention is configurable per-customer; hosted defaults are 90 days with paid retention add-ons up to 7 years. For Dedicated/Private customers we support WORM-style immutability (hardware-backed for private deployments), and for hosted we ship append-only snapshots plus signed manifests for tamper-evidence. HIPAA customers receive BAA options and encryption-at-rest+in-transit; data residency controls are available for EU/US regions.

Attachments I uploaded to the Drive link below: a sample audit_manifest.csv (small extract showing signed checksums), and an export_playbook.pdf with step-by-step export and verification commands.

1) I'll start the vendor questionnaire invite today and assign Laura to draft canonical answers for legal/security fields.
2) Marcus will prepare a one-off export (redacted) from a staging tenant to demonstrate the NDJSON schema and signature verification; ETA: 48 business hours.
3) Schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive to walk through immutability and verification steps (Marcus + infra on the call). Proposed times: Tue 2027-04-13 09:00 or Wed 2027-04-14 14:00 PT — let me know which works.
